retirements.evidence: OpenStreetMap history shows nodes 14155665881, 14155665882 and 14155665883 moved about 35 m at 2026-11-04T17:16:34Z. The 2026-11-06 12:34 UTC refresh candidate merges those nodes into the successor row, which cites them as sources. Eight consecutive refresh candidates (2026-11-04 18:34 to 2026-11-06 12:34 UTC) lacked this ID. The identity rule does not preserve an old ID when two baseline stations match one new row. The production community database holds no references to this ID. Links saved on devices were not checked, and lookups do not read successor_id, so a saved link to this ID stops resolving.
